info.title: TripeE MVP API
info.description: Baseline approved 2026-10-01; not an implemented server. Companion: docs/api-v1.md. JSON camelCase; bigint IDs are strings. Admin session + CSRF. Workflow constraints remain normative in companion document.

servers.description: Same-origin frontend/API proxy; local port is deployment configuration

get.description: Returns all visible PUBLIC/PREPARING markers for the MVP; HIDDEN/deleted excluded. No silent pagination/truncation. Clustering is client-side.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Optional country filter

get.summary: 도시 상세 또는 준비 중 안내
get.description: PUBLIC combines current general and current safety revisions. PREPARING returns only safe basic fields. HIDDEN/deleted return 404. Experience limit 3. No admin evidence notes or storage keys.

Returns CITY/COUNTRY typed results from visible registered destinations only. Exact then prefix then substring; stable type/id tie-break. No external geocoding. Empty matches = items:[]. Country map extent comes from client country-boundary configuration.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed Korean/English city/country search

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Default 10

get.description: All active tags. Tag filtering is not added to MVP merely because a dictionary exists.

Anonymous access only if asset is referenced by a PUBLIC city current revision. Authenticated active admin may view retained assets for editing/history. Otherwise 404. Deleted assets unavailable. Never expose filesystem paths.
Accessible before login. Response no-store. Login rotates session; fetch a fresh token after login/logout.

post.description: CSRF protected even before authentication. Rotate server session ID; Set-Cookie session. Generic credentials error. No signup API.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
